checks.name: simpson
checks.note: Report domains and cohorts separately. Beauty candidate-minus-scalar N10 changes sign between primary and all; retain predeclared primary pool, do not choose the favorable denominator.

checks.name: ecological
checks.note: Mean benefit does not mean every user benefits; retain per-seed top10 gains/losses.

checks.name: berkson
checks.note: Primary excludes previous512 and fit-role users by fixed membership; generalization beyond this selected, repeatedly used validation cohort is unproven.

checks.name: collider
checks.note: No restriction to target-in-candidates or outcome-selected responders; all planned rows retained.

checks.name: base_rate
checks.note: Report cohort sizes, absolute N10/H10/H50, absolute differences and relative differences.

checks.name: regression_to_mean
checks.note: Same-user matched controls; configuration informed by past exploration, so gains are not fresh confirmation.

checks.name: survivorship
checks.note: Both domains and all three seeds of all three arms completed; no dropped evaluation rows.

checks.name: look_elsewhere
checks.note: Multiple exploratory comparisons without multiplicity correction; no confirmatory significance claim. H50 is a predeclared secondary metric, not a replacement for the weak primary N10 contrast.

checks.name: forking_paths
checks.note: Protocol and code hashes match the launch; past three-expert experiments and failed compact heads informed this design and remain part of the record.

checks.name: causation
checks.note: Matched computational contrast supports this configuration only; H50 ranking coverage is not proof of improved generation or causal user behavior.

checks.name: reverse_causality
checks.note: Features are score/history based; targets are used for fit losses/evaluation, not candidate construction. No behavioral causal direction inferred.
